name: Jefferson County, KY
findings: Jefferson County has 3,125 nonprofit organizations. 1,219 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 1,007 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Jefferson County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few arts and cultural organizations list volunteering
observations.text: 12 arts and cultural organizations here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 31 would.

confidence.text: Based on 31 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for ways to volunteer through arts and cultural groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 236 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
